aiResearchSummary.text: Popl is focusing on developing technologies that enhance digital interactions at events. One area of research involves NFC device activation for teams, where an activation computing device captures an image of a visual credential to extract an activation link associated with a profile. Another development is a method and device for sharing social media profiles, utilizing an accessory with an NFC tag that transmits interaction data when attached to an electronic device. These innovations aim to streamline event lead capture and digital business card functionalities.
